1.0 Scope:
This Inspection and test plan covers the minimum testing requirements of the Control Valve. The
scope of inspection shall be as per PO/contractual requirements. The Sub-
contractor/Manufacturer/Vendor/Supplier shall prepare stage wise Inspection and Testing Plan in
detail complying the applicable specification, MR & DS requirements and shall submit for
review/approval.
2.0 Reference documents:
1. PO/MR/PR/Standards referred there in/Job specifications/Approved documents.
3.0 Legends: -
H: Hold for Inspection, do not proceed, R: Review/Check/Verify documents, W: Witness
PO: Purchase order; WPS: Welding procedure specification; PQR: Procedure qualification record;
NDE: Non-destructive examination; PT: Penetrant testing; MT: Magnetic particle testing; RT:
Radiographic testing; TPIA: Third party inspection agency; MTC: Material Test Certificate; TC: Test
Certificate
4.0 Notes: -
1. This s Indicative Inspection and Test Plan (IITP) only. Vendor shall prepare detailed Inspection and
Test Plan based on Project Specifications and IITP.
2. In case of conflict between purchase specification, contract documents and ITP, conditions that
are more stringent shall be applicable.
3. Type/Special Test Certificate offered for review shall not be more than 5 years old from the PO
date, in absence of the same, Type test has to be performed on each rating from accredited test
agency.
4. Acceptance norms for all the activities shall be as per PO/PR/Standards referred there in/Job
specification/Approved documents.
5. Vendor shall carry out additional testing required, if any not specified above, as per PO/Technical
specification.
6. Calibration status of measuring and monitoring instruments/machines to be verified by TPIA
during inspection activities.
7. ITP shall be approved by LTHE.
5.0 Definitions: -
Hold Point - Fabrication shall be kept under hold until inspection has been performed or written
clearance is obtained by vendor.
Witness Point - Advise of inspection, Fabrication may be continued if inspector is not present after
invitation issued in due time.
Review Point - Review of Test Reports/Certificates/Inspection Reports
Approval Point - Approval Required for Documents
